official.description: HEC describes the scheme as the Government of Pakistan offering scholarships to Bangladesh's youth 'for their capacity building through imparting quality education to 500 scholars' in Medicine, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, Mass Communication, Media Studies and Basic & Social Sciences, studied in Pakistani public and private sector universities. The corridor's stated aim is to strengthen the bilateral relationship between Pakistan and Bangladesh and to enhance people-to-people contacts between both states. HEC calls it a fully funded scholarship covering tuition, stipend, hostel and mess charges, settlement allowance, an air ticket and books and stationery.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a Pakistan-funded, fully packaged award that only Bangladeshi citizens can win: HEC places 500 scholars into Pakistani public and private universities at Bachelor's, Master's and PhD level and pays tuition, a stipend, hostel and mess charges, a settlement allowance, an air ticket and books and stationery. You apply through the HEC Scholarship Portal, then every registered candidate sits an HEC test run with the Pakistan High Commission in Dhaka and Bangladesh's Ministry of Higher Education, and only shortlisted candidates reach an online interview. Because HEC publishes no rupee amounts anywhere, treat the money as a package to be confirmed in your offer letter rather than a number you can budget against. The decisive catch is the service bond: HEC requires you to work in Bangladesh after you finish studying in Pakistan.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Bangladeshi nationals with strong intermediate or degree marks in medicine, engineering, computing, business, media or the basic and social sciences who want a fully funded degree inside Pakistan and will accept returning home to serve.
application_readiness_checklist: Check the Pak-Bangladesh Knowledge Corridor AISB page for a new closing date before you plan anything - HEC's published date (10 June 2026) has passed
Create your HEC Scholarship Portal account (scholarship.hec.gov.pk/#/pbs) early, since registration is what makes you eligible to sit the test
Confirm your qualification is complete before the closing date - HEC requires the requisite qualification to be acquired on or before the last date of application
If any certificate is from outside the Bangladesh or Pakistan systems, start the IBCC and then HEC equivalence process months ahead
Prepare for the HEC-conducted test and interview in Dhaka; the test is open to all registered candidates, so entry to the round is not itself selective
Read the service obligation to Bangladesh before you commit, and get family agreement on it
common_rejection_risks: Missing the mark thresholds exactly: 60% for general Bachelor's entry, 65% for Pre-Medical and Pre-Engineering, and 3.00 CGP or 65% for Master's and PhD
Being outside the age band - 17-23 for BS programmes and a maximum of 35 for doctoral programmes
Not holding the qualification by the closing date, which HEC states as a hard condition
Any inconsistency between the form and the certificates: HEC explicitly terminates the scholarship for misinformation or misrepresentation at any stage
Assuming university choice is yours: HEC states placement is solely at its discretion
Expecting an offer without the HEC test or interview stage
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: HEC does not publish what falls outside the package, so budget for personal spending beyond the hostel and mess arrangement, any visa, attestation, medical-test and equivalence fees, and travel inside Pakistan or extra trips home beyond the single air ticket HEC lists.
document_audit: Foreign qualification holders need both an IBCC and an HEC Equivalence Certificate - two separate processes, so start early
HEC physically examines the original documents, so keep certified originals and exact-matching transcripts ready rather than scans alone
The age and qualification evidence has to line up with HEC's stated cut-offs, because the merit list is built from the information you provide
Citizenship proof is mandatory since the award is restricted to Bangladesh citizens
alerts: The published closing date of 10 June 2026 is in the past and no new round date is posted - treat this as a watch-and-wait scheme, not a live call
Placement is entirely at HEC's discretion, so you cannot choose or guarantee your university or city
There is a binding obligation to serve Bangladesh after completing your studies in Pakistan
Instruction is in English even though the award is for Bangladeshi students studying in Pakistan
HEC's April 2026 steering-committee meeting signalled more Bangladeshi places and MS-level awards in later phases, so future rounds may be larger
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register and submit the online form on the HEC Scholarship Portal, sit the HEC test held with the Pakistan High Commission in Dhaka and Bangladesh's Ministry of Higher Education, then await an online interview if shortlisted.
